name: Gemini XII
about: Gemini XII (1966-104A), a crewed vehicle (Gemini), launched 1966 Nov 11. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1966 Nov 14), held fixed
docked to S02565; it stays docked here until it lands, as the undocking is not in GCAT's tables or Wikidata
landing day from Wikidata (P620, Q259770), noon UTC standing in for the hour; no site given; the point is a stand-in
